<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_IncidentProcess"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/incident-process">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IncidentManagement" name="Incident Management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentReported" name="Incident reported"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIncident" name="Log incident report in tracking system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign report to appropriate team"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather necessary information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCause" name="Identify cause of incident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeActions" name="Propose corrective actions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution (fix, training, or policy change)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Follow up to ensure issue will not recur"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete closure and notification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentClosed" name="Incident report closed and stakeholders notified"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" targetRef="Task_LogIncident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogIncident" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
